findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Observed water bottles to be stored outside of gas station. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on proper storage of bottle and water will be moved inside. Ensure items are stored in a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-307.11 Miscellaneous Sources of Contamination. FOOD shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 - 3-306.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Observed employee turn off faucet without using a barrier. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on proper hand washing techique, employee rehashed hands. Ensure a barrier is used when turning off faucet to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed two sanitizer buckets to be at improper concentration, 100 ppm and 0 ppm (Quat). Discussed with PIC, sanitizer buckets were remade. Ensure facility is remaking sanitizer buckets and testing them at a frequency to ensure sanitizer buckets are at the correct concentration. 

4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Observed walk in freezer to have a temperature of 50F. Discussed with PIC, all items located in freezer were thawed and will be discarded.  Ensure freezers are maintaining the correct temperature, do not use until corrected.  

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Observed multiple items in the cold holding station to be past their discard date. Discussed with PIC, items were pulled and discarded. Ensure all products dated in the cold holding station are correctly dated and are discarded if past their discard date. 

3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C). (E)  Does not apply to repacked from a bulk container (C). (F) Does not apply to shellstock (C).  (G) Exemptions: prepared deli salads prepared according to 21 CFR 110; hard cheeses (39% moisture); semi-soft cheeses (50% or less); cultured dairy products (yogurt, sour cream, buttermilk); preserved fish (pickled herring, dried/salted); dry, fermented sausages (pepperoni); and salt-cured products (prosciutto and parma).

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed walk in cooler fans to have an accumulation of dust. Discussed with PIC. Ensure walk in cooler fans are cleaned at a frequency to prevent dust accumulation. 

4-601.11: (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed the following physical facility repairs:
Repeat 1. Mop sink has moldy caulk around the basin (Re-caulk). 
Repeat 2. Hand sinks in both bathrooms (Re-caulk).
New 3. Triple sink in back (Re-caulk).   
New 4. Multiple holes through back storage area (Re-caulk).
New 5. Trim piece to the left of triple sink is coming off (Reattach). 
New 6. Coving under back hand sink not present. 
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE.
